introHtml: 12 oz nursing scrubs offer a heavier, more durable fabric that withstands frequent washing and daily wear in demanding healthcare environments. The added weight provides a professional drape and resists wrinkles, keeping your staff looking sharp through long shifts. Ideal for embroidery or screen printing, these scrubs maintain their color and shape after repeated laundering. Whether outfitting a hospital floor or a private practice, 12 oz polyester-cotton blends deliver the comfort and longevity your team needs.
